title: Beta-Blockers for the Treatment of Arrhythmias: Which Drug for Which Arrhythmia? A State-of-the-Art Narrative Review.
summary: Beta-blockers are among the most widely prescribed drugs in the management of both supraventricular and ventricular arrhythmias, and they are frequently regarded as a homogeneous pharmacological class. They are not. The agents in current use differ substantially in beta1-receptor selectivity, lipophilicity, half-life, route of administration, intrinsic sympathomimetic activity, and ancillary properties, and arrhythmias themselves differ in mechanism, adrenergic dependence, anatomical origin, and structural substrate. This narrative review examines whether these pharmacological differences translate into clinically meaningful differences in efficacy and utility, asking not only whether a beta-blocker should be used but which one should be used. Evidence was drawn from a targeted search of PubMed, Web of Science, Scopus, Ovid, Embase, and the Cochrane Library, with priority given to randomized controlled trials, meta-analyses, large registries, and contemporary society guidelines, and was synthesized qualitatively by arrhythmia type. A class effect is apparent for many indications, particularly rate control in atrial fibrillation and atrial flutter, where metoprolol, bisoprolol, and carvedilol perform broadly similarly and the choice is driven mainly by comorbidity and tolerability. Drug-specific differences emerge in three settings. In adrenergically mediated inherited syndromes, namely catecholaminergic polymorphic ventricular tachycardia and long QT syndrome, nonselective agents and especially nadolol are clearly superior to beta1-selective agents, and the same principle appears to extend to ventricular electrical storm, in which propranolol has outperformed metoprolol in a randomized comparison. In acute care, pharmacokinetics dominate, and the ultra-short-acting agents esmolol and landiolol permit a degree of titration that longer-acting drugs cannot match. In patients with heart failure and reduced ejection fraction, carvedilol, metoprolol succinate, and bisoprolol should be preferred irrespective of arrhythmia subtype because of their established mortality benefit. Conversely, beta1-selective agents, including the highly selective agent nebivolol, improve tolerability in bronchospastic disease, although this reflects respiratory tolerability rather than any demonstrated antiarrhythmic advantage, and beta-blockers have little role in Brugada syndrome or in bradycardia-dependent acquired torsades de pointes. Beta-blockers should therefore not be treated as interchangeable. Selection should integrate arrhythmic mechanism, structural substrate, and patient characteristics, and head-to-head trials remain conspicuously scarce.

title: Rationale and Design of the Atherosclerosis Risk in Communities Generation 2 (ARIC Gen2) Study.
summary: Type 2 diabetes is a risk factor for cardiac arrhythmias, but it is unknown how specific aberrations in glucose (e.g., episodes of high or low glucose) might contribute to the occurrence of heart rhythm abnormalities. The overarching goal of this study is to address research questions regarding how glucose patterns might contribute to the occurrence of arrhythmias, primarily atrial fibrillation, in adults with diabetes. To fulfill this goal, the Atherosclerosis Risk in Communities (ARIC) Gen2 study recruited 507 community-dwelling adults aged 50-80 years with type 2 diabetes to wear continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) and electrocardiogram (ECG) "patch" monitoring sensors simultaneously for up to 14 days. Gen2 study had high CGM and ECG completeness: the median wear time for sensors was 14 days and approximately 80% of participants wore both sensors for ≥10 days. By combining Gen2 and data from the original ongoing ARIC cohort (aged 80+), we have the capacity to conduct a comprehensive evaluation of the impact of CGM-defined glucose patterns on arrhythmias across a wide age spectrum from middle-aged to very old adults (aged 50-100) with type 2 diabetes. The findings from this study may help inform clinical strategies for the prevention and management of arrhythmias among adults with type 2 diabetes.

title: Investigating the Short-Term Changes of the Electrocardiogram Indicators During Hospitalization in Patients With COVID-19 Following the Use of Tocilizumab.
summary:
OBJECTIVES: To evaluate short-term changes in electrocardiographic (ECG) parameters after tocilizumab administration in COVID-19 patients, considering the drug's role in treating severe cases and the involvement of IL-6 in cardiovascular effects and ECG alterations.

METHODS: In this retrospective study, we assessed cardiovascular and electrocardiographic parameters in PCR-confirmed COVID-19 patients who received tocilizumab. ECG variables were evaluated at two time points: 24 h before and 24 h after drug administration. All ECGs were verified by a supervisor, and demographic information was extracted from patient records.

RESULTS: 33 patients were included, of whom 36.4% were men. The patients' ages ranged from 37 to 79 years. The corrected QT interval (QTc) measured 24 h before (QTc1) and 24 h after (QTc2) tocilizumab administration showed no significant difference (QTc1: 390.3 ± 31.67 ms; QTc2: 392.73 ± 36.68 ms). No significant ECG changes were observed in the ST segment, ventricular fibrillation (VF), ventricular tachycardia (VT), or atrial fibrillation (AF). Four patients experienced cardiorespiratory arrest within 24 h after receiving tocilizumab.

CONCLUSION: Tocilizumab administration in critically ill COVID-19 patients was not associated with significant short-term ECG changes or specific cardiovascular complications. Although previous studies in inflammatory diseases such as rheumatoid arthritis have reported QTc shortening following tocilizumab treatment, likely through suppression of IL-6-mediated systemic inflammation, no significant QTc reduction was observed in our cohort during the 24-h follow-up period. A few cases of cardiorespiratory arrest occurred; a causal relationship with tocilizumab could not be established due to the severity of illness and limited clinical data.

AI.conclusion: 重症COVID-19患者使用托珠单抗后24小时内未观察到显著短期心电图改变或特定心血管并发症，未重现既往炎症性疾病中QTc缩短的现象；少数心肺骤停病例因病情严重且临床资料有限，无法确立与托珠单抗的因果关系。本研究样本量小、回顾性设计，结论需更大规模前瞻性研究验证。

结果：共纳入33例患者，其中36.4%为男性。患者年龄范围为37至79岁。托珠单抗给药前24小时（QTc1）和给药后24小时（QTc2）测量的校正QT间期（QTc）显示无显著差异（QTc1：390.3 ± 31.67 ms；QTc2：392.73 ± 36.68 ms）。在ST段、心室颤动（VF）、室性心动过速（VT）或心房颤动（AF）方面未观察到显著的ECG变化。四名患者在接受托珠单抗后24小时内发生心肺骤停。

结论：重症COVID-19患者使用托珠单抗与显著的短期ECG变化或特定心血管并发症无关。尽管先前在类风湿关节炎等炎症性疾病中的研究报告称托珠单抗治疗后QTc缩短，可能通过抑制IL-6介导的全身性炎症实现，但在我们的队列中，24小时随访期间未观察到显著的QTc降低。发生了少数心肺骤停病例；由于疾病严重程度和有限的临床数据，无法建立与托珠单抗的因果关系。

title: From twelve leads to single: Cross-lead knowledge distillation for domain-generalized atrial fibrillation detection
summary: Atrial fibrillation (AF) detection from long-term ambulatory electrocardiography (ECG) is critical because AF is a leading cause of stroke yet is frequently missed by conventional diagnostics, particularly in wearable settings that demand strong cross-domain generalization. Deep learning has improved AF identification by exploiting rhythm patterns, but methods such as BMIRC and SJTU-ECGNet still struggle to generalize across heterogeneous single-lead wearable datasets. To address this issue, we propose X-LeadGen, a two-stage cross-lead distillation framework for single-lead ECG AF detection that explicitly targets domain generalization. First, a 12-lead teacher network distills rich multi-lead information into a single-lead student through cross-lead knowledge transfer and a simulated self-distillation branch within the teacher, improving cross-lead representation alignment and AF discrimination. Second, we introduce a domain-generalization strategy that applies domain-adversarial training in both teacher and student stages, complemented by GANs-based augmentation in the student phase to learn domain-invariant features and enhance robustness to distribution shifts. Across seven public ECG datasets under real and simulated Lead-I settings, X-LeadGen consistently outperforms existing approaches in accuracy and F1-score, demonstrating strong generalization for real-world wearable AF monitoring. Our implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/Aveiro-Lin/X-LeadGen , enabling further research and validation in the ECG community.

AI.tldr: X-LeadGen 通过12导联教师网络向单导联学生网络进行跨导联知识蒸馏，并结合域对抗训练与GAN增强，在7个公开心电数据集上AF检测的准确率与F1均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: AF是卒中的重要原因，但常规诊断常漏诊，长程动态心电监测尤其是单导联可穿戴设备是重要补充手段；既往深度学习方法（如BMIRC、SJTU-ECGNet）在异质性单导联可穿戴数据集间跨域泛化能力不足，缺乏面向真实世界分布偏移的解决方案。
AI.method: 方法学研究，提出两阶段跨导联蒸馏框架X-LeadGen：第一阶段由12导联教师网络通过跨导联知识迁移及教师内部模拟自蒸馏分支，将多导联信息蒸馏至单导联学生网络；第二阶段在教师与学生两阶段均引入域对抗训练，并在学生阶段辅以基于GAN的数据增强，以学习域不变特征。在7个公开心电数据集上，于真实与模拟Lead-I两种设置下评估，主要指标为准确率与F1-score；摘要未报告样本量、具体终点定义细节及统计检验方法。
AI.result: 在7个公开心电数据集的真实与模拟Lead-I设置下，X-LeadGen的准确率与F1-score均持续优于现有对比方法，显示较强的跨域泛化能力；摘要未报告具体效应量、95%置信区间及P值。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明跨导联蒸馏联合域泛化策略可提升单导联可穿戴场景下的AF检测泛化性能，为真实世界长程筛查提供可行思路；但研究仅基于公开数据集的离线评估，缺乏前瞻性临床验证，且摘要未提供量化统计结果，其临床效用尚需进一步证实。

summary_zh: 从长期动态心电图（ECG）中检测心房颤动（AF）至关重要，因为AF是卒中的主要原因，却常被传统诊断方法漏诊，尤其是在需要强跨域泛化的可穿戴设备场景中。深度学习通过利用节律模式改进了AF识别，但BMIRC和SJTU-ECGNet等方法在异构单导联可穿戴数据集间的泛化能力仍显不足。为解决这一问题，我们提出X-LeadGen，一种用于单导联ECG AF检测的两阶段跨导联蒸馏框架，明确针对域泛化。首先，一个12导联教师网络通过跨导联知识迁移和教师内部模拟的自蒸馏分支，将丰富的多导联信息蒸馏到单导联学生网络中，改善跨导联表示对齐和AF判别能力。其次，我们引入一种域泛化策略，在教师和学生阶段均应用域对抗训练，并在学生阶段辅以基于GANs的增强，以学习域不变特征并增强对分布偏移的鲁棒性。在真实和模拟Lead-I设置下的七个公开ECG数据集上，X-LeadGen在准确率和F1分数上始终优于现有方法，展示了在真实世界可穿戴AF监测中的强泛化能力。我们的实现已公开于https://github.com/Aveiro-Lin/X-LeadGen，以促进ECG社区的进一步研究和验证。

title: Resolution of Right Atrial Pacemaker Lead Thrombosis After Rivaroxaban Failure: A Case Report
summary: Background Pacemaker lead thrombosis is a rare but serious complication of cardiac implantable electronic devices (CIEDs) that often mimics infection; its management, given the lack of standardized treatment strategies, requires individualized anticoagulation and dynamic imaging.Case presentation A 65-year-old woman with heart failure and diabetes mellitus had previously undergone dual-chamber pacemaker implantation following radiofrequency catheter ablation. After the subsequent occurrence of ventricular tachycardia, the device was upgraded to a cardiac resynchronization therapy defibrillator (CRT-D). She later experienced recurrent atrial flutter accompanied by worsening heart failure. The timing of atrial flutter recurrence was uncertain, and the patient had not received anticoagulation therapy. Preoperative transesophageal echocardiography (TEE) revealed a mobile mass measuring 10 × 3.5 mm attached to the right atrial lead. Comprehensive clinical and laboratory evaluation showed no evidence of infection. Anticoagulation with rivaroxaban at 20 mg once daily was initiated; however, no reduction in thrombus size was observed after 1 month. The treatment regimen was therefore switched to warfarin, with an initial target international normalized ratio (INR) of 2.0-3.0. Follow-up TEE performed 3 months later demonstrated enlargement of the thrombus to 18 × 3.8 mm. The target INR was subsequently intensified to 2.5-3.0, after which the thrombus gradually regressed. Serial TEE examinations confirmed complete thrombus resolution by 6 months. No embolic or bleeding complications occurred during the treatment course.Conclusion This case underscores the inadequacy of NOAC monotherapy in selected high-risk patients with lead-associated thrombus, and demonstrates that INR-guided warfarin therapy with individualized adjustment was effective in achieving thrombus resolution.

title: Peri-Coronary Adipose Tissue Attenuation and Atrial Fibrillation Recurrence After Catheter Ablation: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Catheter ablation is an established rhythm-control strategy for atrial fibrillation (AF), but arrhythmia recurrence after the procedure remains a major clinical challenge. Reliable pre-procedural biomarkers reflecting the underlying inflammatory substrate may improve risk stratification and patient selection. Peri-coronary adipose tissue (PCAT) attenuation, measured on coronary computed tomography angiography (CCTA), is a noninvasive imaging marker of coronary perivascular inflammation. This study evaluated the association between PCAT attenuation and AF recurrence after catheter ablation.

METHODS: We systematically searched PubMed, Embase, and the Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials through October 2024, following the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) 2020 guidelines, for studies comparing PCAT attenuation between patients with and without AF recurrence after catheter ablation. Pooled mean differences (MDs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were calculated separately for each coronary territory using random-effects models with restricted maximum likelihood estimation of the between-study variance and Knapp-Hartung-Sidik-Jonkman-corrected confidence intervals, an approach recommended when the number of available studies is small. DerSimonian-Laird estimates with Wald intervals are reported alongside for comparison. Standardized MDs were calculated in parallel. Heterogeneity was assessed using the I² statistic, and leave-one-out analysis was performed as a descriptive check.

RESULTS: Three retrospective cohort studies enrolling 852 patients (239, 28%, with AF recurrence) met the inclusion criteria. PCAT attenuation was numerically higher in patients with AF recurrence across all three major coronary territories, but under the small-sample-corrected model, none of the associations reached statistical significance: right coronary artery (RCA)-PCAT (MD 2.62 HU; 95% CI -2.41 to 7.65), left anterior descending artery (LAD)-PCAT (MD 1.53 HU; 95% CI -1.45 to 4.50), and left circumflex artery (LCx)-PCAT (MD 2.48 HU; 95% CI -0.70 to 5.66). Corresponding standardized MDs were 0.30, 0.23, and 0.36. Conventional DerSimonian-Laird estimates with Wald intervals were nominally significant in all three territories despite identical point estimates, reflecting the degree to which precision is overstated when the between-study variance is estimated from three studies. Because each patient contributed correlated measurements across territories, no overall pooled estimate combining territories was calculated. Heterogeneity was moderate (I² 34-65%) but imprecisely estimated.

CONCLUSION: Pre-ablation PCAT attenuation was consistently higher in patients who subsequently experienced AF recurrence after catheter ablation, but the pooled differences of approximately 1.5-2.6 HU did not reach statistical significance once appropriate small-sample corrections were applied and are of a magnitude comparable to reported technical variability in PCAT measurement across CT acquisition protocols. The consistent direction of effect across three independent cohorts is of interest and supports further investigation, but these data do not establish PCAT attenuation as a predictor of post-ablation recurrence and provide no basis for clinical application. Prospective multicenter studies with standardized acquisition and segmentation protocols are needed.

AI.tldr: 术前PCAT衰减在房颤消融后复发患者中数值上较高，但汇总差异约1.5-2.6 HU，经小样本校正后无统计学显著性，不足以作为预测指标。
AI.motivation: 导管消融是房颤节律控制策略，但术后复发常见。需要可靠的术前生物标志物反映炎症基质以改善风险分层。PCAT衰减是CCTA测量的无创冠脉周围炎症影像标志物，但其与消融后复发的关系尚不明确。
AI.method: 系统综述与荟萃分析，检索PubMed、Embase和Cochrane图书馆至2024年10月，纳入比较消融后复发与未复发患者PCAT衰减的研究。计算各冠脉区域的汇总均数差（MD）及95%CI，采用随机效应模型（限制性最大似然估计研究间方差，Knapp-Hartung-Sidik-Jonkman校正CI），同时报告DerSimonian-Laird估计，计算标准化MD，用I²评估异质性，并进行留一法分析。
AI.result: 纳入3项回顾性队列研究，共852例患者（239例，28%复发）。复发患者三个冠脉区域的PCAT衰减均数值较高，但校正模型下均无统计学显著性：RCA-PCAT MD 2.62 HU（95%CI -2.41至7.65），LAD-PCAT MD 1.53 HU（95%CI -1.45至4.50），LCx-PCAT MD 2.48 HU（95%CI -0.70至5.66）；标准化MD分别为0.30、0.23、0.36。传统DerSimonian-Laird估计名义上显著，但点估计相同，反映小样本时精度被高估。异质性中等（I² 34-65%）但估计不精确。因各区域测量相关，未计算总体合并估计。
AI.conclusion: 术前PCAT衰减在消融后复发患者中方向一致地较高，但差异幅度约1.5-2.6 HU，与小样本校正后无统计学显著性，且与CT采集协议间测量技术变异相当。这些数据不支持PCAT衰减作为消融后复发的预测指标，无临床适用依据。需要前瞻性多中心研究采用标准化采集和分割协议进一步验证。

结论：消融前PCAT衰减在随后发生导管消融后AF复发的患者中一致较高，但一旦应用适当的小样本校正，约1.5-2.6 HU的合并差异未达到统计学显著性，且其幅度与报道的PCAT测量在不同CT采集方案间的技术变异性相当。三个独立队列中效应方向的一致性值得关注并支持进一步研究，但这些数据并未确立PCAT衰减作为消融后复发的预测因子，也未提供临床应用的依据。需要采用标准化采集和分割方案的前瞻性多中心研究。

title: Spontaneous Perigastric Hematoma and Hemoperitoneum Associated With Rivaroxaban Therapy: A Case Report and Review of the Literature
summary: Spontaneous hemoperitoneum is a rare but potentially life-threatening complication of direct oral anticoagulant (DOAC) therapy.We report the case of a 59-year-old man receiving long-term rivaroxaban for atrial flutter, previously treated with tricuspid isthmus ablation, who was admitted for atypical chest pain and subsequently developed acute abdominal pain during observation.Contrast-enhanced computed tomography (CT) revealed spontaneous intra-abdominal hemorrhage presenting as a perigastric hematoma with hemoperitoneum, with the perigastric component measuring 96 mm × 58 mm, without active contrast extravasation or an underlying focal lesion.Throughout the admission, the patient remained hemodynamically stable, with no active contrast extravasation on CT and only a moderate decline in hemoglobin levels, from 14.8 g/dL at admission to a nadir of 12.3 g/dL, without requiring transfusion.He was managed with interruption of rivaroxaban and close clinical and biological monitoring alone, with full recovery and no invasive procedure required.A focused review of six comparable published cases of rivaroxaban-associated spontaneous intra-abdominal hemorrhage showed that most required invasive intervention for hemodynamic instability, underscoring the favorable outcome in this hemodynamically stable patient and supporting an individualized, severity-adapted approach to management.The case is notable for the combination of a sizeable perigastric hematoma, moderate hemoperitoneum, absence of active extravasation, hemodynamic stability, and successful non-invasive management.This combination appears to be rarely reported among previously published rivaroxaban-associated intra-abdominal hemorrhages, which predominantly required invasive intervention.

title: External Validation and Bayesian Forecasting of Rivaroxaban Population Pharmacokinetic Models in Older Chinese Patients with Nonvalvular Atrial Fibrillation.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Population pharmacokinetic (PopPK) models have been developed to characterize rivaroxaban exposure; however, their transferability across different clinical populations remains uncertain. This study aimed to externally evaluate published rivaroxaban PopPK models in older Chinese patients with nonvalvular atrial fibrillation (NVAF) and assess whether Bayesian forecasting could improve individual concentration prediction.

METHODS: Six published rivaroxaban PopPK models were evaluated using an independent cohort from the RIVA-GAP study. Predictive performance was assessed using prediction error metrics reflecting bias, precision, and prediction coverage, together with normalized prediction distribution error (NPDE) diagnostics. Bayesian forecasting was performed using paired steady-state trough-peak concentrations to evaluate changes in individual peak concentration prediction.

RESULTS: A total of 135 patients with 257 rivaroxaban concentration observations were included for external validation, and 122 patients with paired trough-peak samples were included for Bayesian forecasting. Predictive performance varied substantially among the six models, and none consistently met predefined acceptance criteria. Model A showed comparatively lower prediction bias among the evaluated models but still demonstrated limited precision (MDPE 33.64%, MDAPE 53.72%, F30 31.52%). Bayesian forecasting reduced the MDIPE of Model A from 33.64% to 12.38%, but MAIPE remained 37.33% and IF30 was 41.8%. Similar model-dependent effects were observed across the other models.

CONCLUSION: Published rivaroxaban PopPK models demonstrated heterogeneous transferability in older Chinese patients with NVAF. Bayesian forecasting using a single trough concentration provided modest and model-dependent improvement in concentration prediction but did not consistently overcome limitations of the underlying models.

CLINICAL TRIAL/STUDY REGISTRATION: Chinese Clinical Trial Registry, ChiCTR2300074934; registered 21 August 2023.

AI.motivation: 利伐沙班群体药代动力学（PopPK）模型已用于描述药物暴露，但其在不同临床人群间的可迁移性尚不明确，尤其缺乏老年中国非瓣膜性房颤（NVAF）患者的验证数据。
AI.method: 基于RIVA-GAP研究的独立队列，外部验证6个已发表的利伐沙班PopPK模型，纳入135例患者共257个浓度观测；采用反映偏倚、精度和预测覆盖率的预测误差指标及NPDE诊断评估预测性能；另纳入122例有配对稳态谷-峰浓度的患者进行贝叶斯预测，评估个体峰浓度预测的改善。
AI.result: 6个模型预测性能差异显著，无一持续满足预设接受标准。Model A预测偏倚相对较低但精度有限（MDPE 33.64%，MDAPE 53.72%，F30 31.52%）。贝叶斯预测将Model A的MDIPE从33.64%降至12.38%，但MAIPE仍为37.33%，IF30为41.8%；其他模型也观察到类似依赖模型的效果。
AI.conclusion: 已发表的利伐沙班PopPK模型在老年中国NVAF患者中可迁移性异质，单点谷浓度贝叶斯预测仅带来适度且依赖模型的改善，未能持续克服基础模型的局限性，提示临床个体化给药需谨慎解读模型预测。

背景：已建立群体药代动力学（PopPK）模型以表征利伐沙班的暴露特征；然而，这些模型在不同临床人群间的可转移性仍不确定。本研究旨在外部评估已发表的利伐沙班PopPK模型在老年中国非瓣膜性心房颤动（NVAF）患者中的表现，并评估贝叶斯预测能否改善个体浓度预测。

方法：使用来自RIVA-GAP研究的独立队列对六个已发表的利伐沙班PopPK模型进行评估。采用反映偏倚、精度和预测覆盖率的预测误差指标以及标准化预测分布误差（NPDE）诊断来评估预测性能。使用配对的稳态谷-峰浓度进行贝叶斯预测，以评估个体峰浓度预测的变化。

结果：共纳入135例患者、257个利伐沙班浓度观测值用于外部验证，纳入122例有配对谷-峰样本的患者用于贝叶斯预测。六个模型的预测性能差异显著，且没有一个模型能持续满足预设的接受标准。在评估的模型中，模型A显示出相对较低的预测偏倚，但精度仍然有限（MDPE 33.64%，MDAPE 53.72%，F30 31.52%）。贝叶斯预测将模型A的MDIPE从33.64%降至12.38%，但MAIPE仍为37.33%，IF30为41.8%。在其他模型中也观察到类似的模型依赖性效应。

结论：已发表的利伐沙班PopPK模型在老年中国NVAF患者中表现出异质的可转移性。使用单次谷浓度的贝叶斯预测对浓度预测提供了适度且依赖于模型的改善，但未能持续克服基础模型的局限性。

title: Atrial fibrillation and sudden cardiac death: mechanisms, management, and new therapeutic targets.

Transient sinus arrest caused by coronary spasm of the sinus node artery after pulsed field ablation for superior vena cava isolation: a case report
summary: Background Pulsed field ablation (PFA) has emerged as a novel non-thermal ablation modality with preferential myocardial selectivity. However, its effects on adjacent structures, including the sinus node and its arterial supply, remain incompletely understood.Case summary A 72-year-old woman underwent repeat ablation for recurrent paroxysmal atrial fibrillation. Following pulmonary vein isolation, superior vena cava (SVC) isolation was performed using a PFA system. Sinus rhythm was initially preserved. However, sinus arrest developed several minutes after ablation. High right atrial backup pacing was initiated. Coronary angiography revealed severe spasm of the sinus node artery. Sinus node function gradually recovered after supportive management. Post-procedural voltage mapping confirmed successful SVC isolation.Discussion This case highlights delayed sinus arrest following SVC isolation using PFA, with angiographic evidence suggesting sinus node artery spasm. While multiple mechanisms may contribute to sinus node dysfunction after PFA, coronary vasospasm should be considered, particularly in cases with delayed onset.

AI.tldr: 72岁女性房颤再次消融，PFA行上腔静脉隔离后数分钟出现窦性停搏，冠脉造影证实窦房结动脉严重痉挛，支持治疗后窦房结功能恢复。
AI.motivation: PFA作为非热消融方式对心肌有选择性，但对邻近结构（包括窦房结及其动脉供血）的影响尚不清楚；SVC隔离后迟发窦性停搏的机制缺乏报道，临床识别与处理经验有限。
AI.method: 个案报告。72岁女性，复发性阵发性房颤再次消融，先完成肺静脉隔离，再用PFA系统行上腔静脉隔离；观察术中窦性心律与术后迟发心律失常，行冠脉造影明确病因，术后电压标测确认SVC隔离效果。样本量1例，无对照与统计检验。
AI.result: PFA后初期窦性心律保留，数分钟后出现窦性停搏，启动高位右心房备用起搏；冠脉造影示窦房结动脉严重痉挛，支持治疗后窦房结功能逐渐恢复；术后电压标测证实SVC隔离成功。摘要未报告具体时间、心率及随访时长等数值。
AI.conclusion: PFA行SVC隔离后可出现迟发性窦性停搏，冠脉痉挛是需考虑的可逆机制之一；术中术后应加强心律监测并备好起搏，迟发停搏时应评估窦房结动脉痉挛。但为单例报告，因果关系与发生率尚不能确定。

summary_zh: 背景：脉冲场消融（PFA）已成为一种新型非热消融方式，具有优先心肌选择性。然而，其对邻近结构（包括窦房结及其动脉血供）的影响仍不完全清楚。病例摘要：一名72岁女性因复发性阵发性心房颤动接受再次消融。在肺静脉隔离后，使用PFA系统进行上腔静脉（SVC）隔离。窦性心律最初得以保持。然而，消融后数分钟出现窦性停搏。启动高位右心房备用起搏。冠状动脉造影显示窦房结动脉严重痉挛。经支持治疗后窦房结功能逐渐恢复。术后电压标测证实SVC隔离成功。讨论：本病例强调了使用PFA进行SVC隔离后出现延迟性窦性停搏，血管造影证据提示窦房结动脉痉挛。虽然多种机制可能导致PFA后窦房结功能障碍，但应考虑冠状动脉血管痉挛，尤其是在起病延迟的病例中。

title: Sphingomyelin as a key negative mediator in atrial fibrillation via lipid profiling analysis and functional identification.
summary:
AIMS: Atrial fibrillation (AF) has emerged as one of the most prevalent cardiac arrhythmias globally, with its incidence continuously rising, thereby elevating it to a major public health concern. The heart is known for its high lipid content, and disorders or abnormalities in lipid metabolism are frequently associated with cardiovascular diseases. This study aimed to investigate the regulatory roles of lipids in AF.

METHODS AND RESULTS: Using tree-based ensemble learning-assisted lipidomics, sphingomyelin was identified as a key differential metabolite and found to be significantly reduced in AF patients. Exogenous supplementation of sphingomyelin significantly attenuated acetylcholine-CaCl2-induced and angiotensin II-induced AF, fibrosis, and inflammation in mice. Furthermore, decreased sphingomyelin levels were attributed to increased activity of sphingomyelin phosphodiesterases (SMPDs) under AF conditions. Mechanistically, RNA-Seq analysis demonstrated that sphingomyelin inhibits AF-induced activation of the Rap1 signalling pathway, a finding corroborated by overexpression and knockdown of RAP1 in vivo.

CONCLUSION: Together, these findings highlight the therapeutic potential of sphingomyelin and SMPD inhibitors in mitigating AF through inhibition of the Rap1 signalling pathway, thereby establishing the targeting of sphingomyelin metabolism as a viable and novel treatment strategy for AF.

AI.tldr: 房颤患者鞘磷脂水平显著降低，外源性补充可减轻小鼠房颤、纤维化与炎症，机制为抑制Rap1信号通路。
AI.motivation: 房颤是全球最常见的心律失常之一，发病率持续上升，构成重大公共卫生问题。心脏富含脂质，脂代谢紊乱常与心血管疾病相关，但脂质在房颤中的调控作用尚不清楚，既往证据存在缺口。
AI.method: 研究采用基于树的集成学习辅助脂质组学，在房颤患者中筛选差异代谢物；随后在小鼠中通过乙酰胆碱-CaCl2及血管紧张素II诱导房颤模型，外源性补充鞘磷脂并评估房颤、纤维化与炎症；检测鞘磷脂磷酸二酯酶（SMPDs）活性；通过RNA-Seq分析及体内RAP1过表达与敲低验证机制。摘要未报告样本量及具体统计方法。
AI.result: 脂质组学鉴定鞘磷脂为关键差异代谢物，在房颤患者中显著降低。外源性补充鞘磷脂显著减轻小鼠乙酰胆碱-CaCl2诱导及血管紧张素II诱导的房颤、纤维化与炎症。房颤条件下鞘磷脂水平下降归因于SMPDs活性增加。RNA-Seq显示鞘磷脂抑制房颤诱导的Rap1信号通路激活，体内RAP1过表达与敲低结果予以佐证。摘要未报告效应量、95%CI及P值。
AI.conclusion: 鞘磷脂及SMPD抑制剂可通过抑制Rap1信号通路减轻房颤，提示靶向鞘磷脂代谢是房颤的潜在新型治疗策略。研究为临床前动物实验，样本量及关键统计数值未在摘要中报告，尚需进一步临床研究验证。

目的：心房颤动（AF）已成为全球最常见的持续性心律失常之一，其发病率持续上升，从而使其成为重大公共卫生问题。心脏以高脂质含量著称，脂质代谢的紊乱或异常常与心血管疾病相关。本研究旨在探讨脂质在AF中的调控作用。

title: ANGPTL2 and CP define complementary circadian-associated signals in atrial fibrillation: integrative transcriptomics and external validation
summary: Introduction Atrial fibrillation (AF) develops through the interplay of electrical, structural, inflammatory, and metabolic remodeling. However, the circadian-associated molecular characteristics of the diseased human atrium remain incompletely understood.Methods We integrated differential expression analysis, circadian gene intersection, weighted gene co-expression network analysis, and complementary feature selection algorithms in a discovery cohort. The prioritized candidate genes were subsequently validated using an independent atrial dataset, human atrial rhythmicity data, single-nucleus transcriptomics, and experimental evidence derived from human and mouse atrial tissues. We additionally performed cross-cohort drug repurposing screening and exploratory molecular docking.Results ANGPTL2 and CP were identified as prioritized candidate genes associated with circadian rhythms. Both genes were consistently upregulated in fibrillating atria but exhibited distinct expression profiles: ANGPTL2 demonstrated stronger discriminatory power at the tissue level, whereas CP showed a larger but more heterogeneous expression alteration. Both genes displayed rhythmic expression patterns in human atrial appendage tissue and were predominantly enriched in vascular and stromal cell populations, establishing a link between temporal atrial biology and inflammatory-metabolic remodeling as well as copper-redox remodeling. The upregulation of their transcripts and proteins was further validated across independent human samples and an arrhythmia-prone mouse model. No compound met the prespecified multi-source criteria for cross-cohort drug repurposing. An independent exploratory analysis of clinically used antiarrhythmic drugs identified favorable molecular docking profiles for both target proteins.Discussion ANGPTL2 and CP are externally validated circadian rhythm-associated candidate genes for atrial fibrillation (AF), and may yield experimentally testable candidate gene-drug pairs. However, these findings do not establish causal regulation by the circadian clock, direct molecular binding, or clinical therapeutic efficacy.

AI.tldr: ANGPTL2和CP被鉴定为房颤中与昼夜节律相关的候选基因，在颤动心房中上调并呈节律性表达，主要富集于血管和基质细胞，但未证实因果调控或临床疗效。
AI.motivation: 房颤涉及电重构、结构重构、炎症和代谢重构的相互作用，但人类病变心房的昼夜节律相关分子特征尚不完全清楚，需要整合多组学数据识别关键基因。
AI.method: 在发现队列中整合差异表达分析、昼夜节律基因交集、加权基因共表达网络分析和互补特征选择算法，筛选候选基因；随后在独立心房数据集、人类心房节律数据、单核转录组以及人和小鼠心房组织实验证据中进行验证；另进行跨队列药物重定位筛选和探索性分子对接。
AI.result: ANGPTL2和CP被优先确定为与昼夜节律相关的候选基因，二者在颤动心房中均持续上调但表达谱不同：ANGPTL2在组织水平区分能力更强，CP表达变化幅度更大但异质性更高。两基因在人心房附件组织中呈节律性表达模式，主要富集于血管和基质细胞群，并与炎症-代谢重构及铜-氧化还原重构相关。其转录本和蛋白上调在独立人类样本和心律失常倾向小鼠模型中得到验证。跨队列药物重定位筛选无化合物满足预设多源标准；对临床抗心律失常药物的独立探索性分析显示，两种靶蛋白均有良好的分子对接特征。
AI.conclusion: ANGPTL2和CP是外部验证的房颤昼夜节律相关候选基因，可能产生可实验测试的候选基因-药物配对，但未证实昼夜节律钟的因果调控、直接分子结合或临床治疗疗效，需进一步功能研究。

summary_zh:
引言 心房颤动（AF）通过电重构、结构重构、炎症重构和代谢重构的相互作用而发生。然而，病变人类心房中与昼夜节律相关的分子特征仍不完全清楚。

方法 我们在发现队列中整合了差异表达分析、昼夜节律基因交集、加权基因共表达网络分析和互补特征选择算法。随后使用独立心房数据集、人类心房节律数据、单核转录组学以及源自人类和小鼠心房组织的实验证据对优先候选基因进行了验证。我们还进行了跨队列药物重定位筛选和探索性分子对接。

结果 ANGPTL2和CP被确定为与昼夜节律相关的优先候选基因。这两个基因在颤动心房中均持续上调，但表现出不同的表达谱：ANGPTL2在组织水平显示出更强的区分能力，而CP显示出更大但更异质的表达改变。这两个基因在人类心耳组织中均表现出节律性表达模式，并主要富集于血管和基质细胞群体，从而建立了时间性心房生物学与炎症-代谢重塑以及铜-氧化还原重塑之间的联系。它们的转录本和蛋白质的上调在独立人类样本和心律失常易感小鼠模型中得到了进一步验证。没有化合物满足跨队列药物重定位的预设多源标准。对临床使用的抗心律失常药物的独立探索性分析确定了两种靶蛋白的有利分子对接谱。

讨论 ANGPTL2和CP是经外部验证的房颤（AF）昼夜节律相关候选基因，并可能产生可实验测试的候选基因-药物配对。然而，这些发现并未确立昼夜节律钟的因果调控、直接分子结合或临床治疗疗效。

title: Concomitant atrial fibrillation ablation and left atrial appendage occlusion: rationale, outcomes, and future directions.
summary: Atrial fibrillation (AF) is the most common sustained cardiac arrhythmia worldwide and remains a major contributor to stroke, heart failure, hospitalization, and cardiovascular mortality. Catheter ablation has become a central strategy for rhythm control, while left atrial appendage occlusion (LAAO) offers an effective mechanical option for stroke prevention in patients with contraindications to oral anticoagulation. Performing AF ablation and LAAO during the same procedure addresses complementary therapeutic goals while potentially improving procedural efficiency, reducing hospital exposure, and enhancing patient convenience. This narrative review summarizes the rationale, patient selection, procedural considerations, clinical outcomes, and future directions of concomitant AF ablation and LAAO. Evidence demonstrates high procedural success rates, generally exceeding 90%, with acceptable acute complication rates in experienced centers. Combined procedures benefit from shared transseptal access, consolidated imaging and anesthesia requirements, and a single recovery period. Rhythm-control efficacy compared with standalone ablation remains unclear, with recurrence rates reported as both elevated and comparable across studies, reflecting the limited randomized data for concomitant procedures. Important knowledge gaps persist regarding optimal sequencing, periprocedural antithrombotic therapy, patient selection, and newer technologies such as pulsed-field ablation. Concomitant AF ablation and LAAO represent a logical and evolving strategy for integrated rhythm and stroke management.

AI.tldr: 同期房颤消融与左心耳封堵术成功率高（>90%），但节律控制疗效是否优于单纯消融尚不明确，缺乏随机对照数据。
AI.motivation: 房颤是卒中和心衰的重要原因，导管消融是节律控制的核心策略，而左心耳封堵为口服抗凝禁忌患者提供卒中预防选择。同期手术可整合治疗目标、提高效率，但关于其疗效和安全性的证据有限，尤其缺乏与单纯消融的随机比较。
AI.method: 叙述性综述，总结同期房颤消融与左心耳封堵术的理论依据、患者选择、手术考虑、临床结局和未来方向。纳入观察性研究和有限随机数据，主要终点包括手术成功率和急性并发症，次要终点包括节律复发率。摘要未报告具体样本量、统计方法和效应量。
AI.result: 在经验丰富的中心，同期手术成功率超过90%，急性并发症率可接受。同期手术可共享房间隔穿刺、影像和麻醉资源，并缩短恢复时间。与单纯消融相比，节律控制疗效不确定，不同研究报告的复发率有升高也有相当。摘要未报告具体数值、95%置信区间或P值。
AI.conclusion: 同期房颤消融与左心耳封堵是整合节律和卒中管理的合理策略，但需更多随机数据明确其相对于单纯消融的获益，并解决最佳顺序、围术期抗栓方案、患者选择及脉冲场消融等新技术应用等知识缺口。

summary_zh: 心房颤动（AF）是全球最常见的持续性心律失常，并且仍然是卒中、心力衰竭、住院和心血管死亡的主要原因。导管消融已成为节律控制的核心策略，而左心耳封堵（LAAO）为存在口服抗凝禁忌证的患者提供了一种有效的机械性卒中预防选择。在同一手术中同时进行AF消融和LAAO，既能实现互补的治疗目标，又可能提高手术效率、减少住院时间并提升患者便利性。本叙述性综述总结了同期AF消融和LAAO的理论依据、患者选择、手术考虑、临床结局和未来方向。证据表明，在有经验的中心，手术成功率高，通常超过90%，且急性并发症发生率可接受。联合手术受益于共享的经房间隔入路、整合的影像学和麻醉需求以及单次恢复期。与单独消融相比的节律控制疗效仍不明确，研究报告的复发率既有升高也有相当，反映出同期手术的随机数据有限。在最佳顺序、围术期抗血栓治疗、患者选择以及脉冲场消融等新技术方面仍存在重要的知识空白。同期AF消融和LAAO代表了一种合理且不断发展的整合节律与卒中管理策略。

title: Ariadne's thread: a standardized mapping workflow using a pentaspline pulsed-field ablation catheter for pulmonary vein isolation.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Pentaspline pulsed-field ablation (PFA) catheters with integrated three-dimensional mapping allow anatomical reconstruction and ablation with a single device. However, standardized catheter-manipulation workflows for reproducible left atrial mapping with these systems remain limited.

TECHNIQUE: Ariadne's Thread is a standardized pulmonary vein (PV)-anchored mapping workflow based on sequential guidewire positioning in each PV, basket-configuration acquisition, gradual catheter pullback from the PV sleeve to the ostium and antrum, and controlled sheath rotation. Repetition of this sequence from the four PVs generates intersecting trajectories that provide broad PV-antral and posterior left atrial coverage, while roof acquisition is completed by reducing guidewire tension and redirecting the basket superiorly.

PRACTICAL CONSIDERATIONS: The workflow is intended for PVI/posterior wall isolation (PWI)-oriented anatomical reconstruction rather than comprehensive high-density substrate mapping. Anterior left atrial, left atrial appendage-PV ridge, septal, and narrow conduction-channel regions may be incompletely sampled and should be assessed with supplementary targeted or dedicated high-density mapping when clinically required.

CONCLUSIONS: Ariadne's Thread provides a structured single-catheter approach to left atrial anatomical mapping during PFA-based PVI/PWI, standardizing catheter manipulation while defining the anatomical scope and limitations of the technique.

AI.tldr: Ariadne's Thread 标准化工作流程以五分支脉冲场消融导管单器械完成左房解剖重建，可覆盖肺静脉前庭与后壁，但前壁、左心耳-肺静脉嵴及间隔区采样不全。
AI.motivation: 五分支脉冲场消融导管整合三维标测，可单器械完成解剖重建与消融，但缺乏可重复的标准化导管操作流程来保证左房标测的一致性，既往证据在此方面存在缺口。
AI.method: 本文为技术描述类论文，报告一套标准化肺静脉锚定标测工作流程：依次将导丝置入四支肺静脉，以篮状构型采集，从肺静脉袖部逐步回撤至开口与前庭，并配合可控鞘管旋转；四支肺静脉重复该序列形成交叉轨迹，覆盖肺静脉前庭与左房后壁，顶部通过降低导丝张力并将篮状结构向上重定向完成。摘要未报告研究类型、样本量、终点定义及统计方法。
AI.result: 摘要未报告定量结果、效应量、95% 置信区间或 P 值。作者指出该流程面向肺静脉隔离/后壁隔离的解剖重建，而非全面高密度基质标测；左房前壁、左心耳-肺静脉嵴、间隔及窄传导通道区域可能采样不全，临床需要时应补充靶向或专用高密度标测。
AI.conclusion: 该流程为脉冲场消融肺静脉隔离/后壁隔离中的左房解剖标测提供结构化单导管操作方案，可标准化导管操作并明确其解剖覆盖范围与局限；但缺乏定量验证数据，对电生理实践的影响尚需临床研究评估其可重复性、标测完整性与操作效率。

summary_zh:
背景：具有集成三维标测功能的五分支脉冲场消融（PFA）导管允许使用单一器械进行解剖重建和消融。然而，使用这些系统进行可重复的左心房标测的标准化导管操作工作流程仍然有限。

技术：Ariadne's Thread 是一种标准化的肺静脉（PV）锚定标测工作流程，基于在每个 PV 中顺序放置导丝、篮状配置采集、导管从 PV 袖套逐渐回撤至开口和前庭，以及受控的鞘管旋转。从四个 PV 重复此序列会产生相交的轨迹，提供广泛的 PV-前庭和左心房后部覆盖，而顶部采集则通过减少导丝张力并将篮状结构向上重定向来完成。

实践考虑：该工作流程旨在用于面向 PVI/后壁隔离（PWI）的解剖重建，而非全面的高密度基质标测。左心房前部、左心耳-PV 嵴、间隔和狭窄传导通道区域可能采样不完整，当临床需要时应通过补充的靶向或专用的高密度标测进行评估。

结论：Ariadne's Thread 提供了一种结构化的单导管方法，用于基于 PFA 的 PVI/PWI 期间的左心房解剖标测，标准化了导管操作，同时定义了该技术的解剖范围和局限性。

title: Catheter Ablation Versus Medical Therapy in Atrial Fibrillation With Heart Failure With Reduced or Mildly Reduced Ejection Fraction: A GRADE-Assessed Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
summary: Background Catheter ablation is an established rhythm-control strategy for atrial fibrillation (AF), but its effectiveness in patients with heart failure with reduced or mildly reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF/HFmrEF) remains incompletely defined. We performed a GRADE-assessed systematic review and meta-analysis comparing catheter ablation with conventional medical therapy in this population.Methods PubMed, Embase, and the Cochrane Library were searched from inception to February 2026. Randomized controlled trials and observational cohort studies enrolling adults with AF and left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) ≤ 50% were included. Primary outcomes were all-cause mortality, cardiovascular mortality, and change in LVEF. Secondary outcomes were change in B-type natriuretic peptide (BNP) and cardiovascular hospitalization. Random-effects models were used, and certainty of evidence was assessed using GRADE.Results Thirteen studies involving 131 492 participants were included. Catheter ablation significantly reduced all-cause mortality (RR 0.61, 95% CI 0.51-0.71) and cardiovascular mortality (RR 0.46, 95% CI 0.31-0.66), improved LVEF (MD 6.47%, 95% CI 4.47-8.47), and reduced BNP levels (MD -136.85 pg/mL, 95% CI -190.46 to -83.23). No significant reduction was observed in cardiovascular hospitalization (RR 0.78, 95% CI 0.53-1.13). Mortality benefits were consistent across subgroup analyses by study design and baseline LVEF.Conclusions Catheter ablation was associated with lower mortality and improved cardiac function compared with medical therapy in patients with AF and HFrEF/HFmrEF. Further studies specifically evaluating HFmrEF populations are warranted.

AI.tldr: 在房颤合并射血分数降低或轻度降低的心衰患者中，导管消融较药物治疗显著降低全因死亡和心血管死亡，并改善左室射血分数。
AI.motivation: 导管消融是房颤节律控制的成熟策略，但其在射血分数降低或轻度降低的心衰（HFrEF/HFmrEF）患者中的疗效尚不明确，既往证据存在缺口。
AI.method: 系统综述与荟萃分析，检索PubMed、Embase和Cochrane Library至2026年2月，纳入成人房颤且LVEF≤50%的随机对照试验和观察性队列研究，共13项研究131,492例参与者。主要终点为全因死亡、心血管死亡和LVEF变化；次要终点为BNP变化和心血管住院。采用随机效应模型，并使用GRADE评估证据确定性。
AI.result: 导管消融显著降低全因死亡（RR 0.61，95%CI 0.51-0.71）和心血管死亡（RR 0.46，95%CI 0.31-0.66），改善LVEF（MD 6.47%，95%CI 4.47-8.47），降低BNP水平（MD -136.85 pg/mL，95%CI -190.46至-83.23）。心血管住院无显著减少（RR 0.78，95%CI 0.53-1.13）。按研究设计和基线LVEF的亚组分析中，死亡获益一致。
AI.conclusion: 在房颤合并HFrEF/HFmrEF患者中，导管消融与药物治疗相比与更低死亡率和改善心功能相关。需进一步开展专门评估HFmrEF人群的研究。

summary_zh:
背景：导管消融是心房颤动（AF）的既定节律控制策略，但其在射血分数降低或轻度降低的心力衰竭（HFrEF/HFmrEF）患者中的有效性仍未完全明确。我们进行了一项GRADE评估的系统综述和荟萃分析，比较导管消融与常规药物治疗在该人群中的效果。

方法：检索了PubMed、Embase和Cochrane Library从建库至2026年2月的文献。纳入招募了AF且左心室射血分数（LVEF）≤ 50%的成年患者的随机对照试验和观察性队列研究。主要结局为全因死亡率、心血管死亡率和LVEF变化。次要结局为B型利钠肽（BNP）变化和心血管住院。使用随机效应模型，并采用GRADE评估证据确定性。

结果：共纳入13项研究，涉及131 492名参与者。导管消融显著降低全因死亡率（RR 0.61，95% CI 0.51-0.71）和心血管死亡率（RR 0.46，95% CI 0.31-0.66），改善LVEF（MD 6.47%，95% CI 4.47-8.47），并降低BNP水平（MD -136.85 pg/mL，95% CI -190.46至-83.23）。未观察到心血管住院的显著减少（RR 0.78，95% CI 0.53-1.13）。按研究设计和基线LVEF进行的亚组分析中，死亡率获益一致。

结论：在AF和HFrEF/HFmrEF患者中，与药物治疗相比，导管消融与较低的死亡率和改善的心功能相关。有必要进一步开展专门评估HFmrEF人群的研究。

title: Hemoglobin Levels as a Marker of Arrhythmia Recurrence After Atrial Fibrillation Ablation
summary: Background Low hemoglobin (Hb) is associated with hemodynamic stress and adverse cardiac remodeling. However, its clinical significance for arrhythmia recurrence after atrial fibrillation (AF) ablation remains unclear.Methods We retrospectively studied 2202 patients undergoing AF ablation between 2014 and 2024 (radiofrequency ablation [RFA]: n = 1606; cryoballoon ablation [CBA]: n = 596). In the RFA cohort, patients were stratified by Hb quartiles, and the lowest quartile cut-off (Hb < 12.4 g/dL) was applied to the CBA cohort. The primary endpoint was AF or atrial tachycardia recurrence beyond a 90-day blanking period.Results In the RFA cohort, low Hb was associated with a higher risk of arrhythmia recurrence after the index procedure (adjusted HR 1.33, 95% CI 1.07-1.65) and after multiple procedures (adjusted HR 1.57, 95% CI 1.22-2.02). No significant association was observed in the CBA cohort (adjusted HR 1.03, 95% CI 0.68-1.54). The interaction between Hb level and ablation modality was not statistically significant (p for interaction = 0.177). In the pooled analysis, low Hb was independently associated with arrhythmia recurrence in the total population (adjusted HR 1.24, 95% CI 1.03-1.50) and in patients with non-paroxysmal AF (adjusted HR 1.43, 95% CI 1.11-1.85), but not in those with paroxysmal AF (adjusted HR 1.06, 95% CI 0.80-1.39).Conclusions Lower Hb levels were associated with an increased risk of arrhythmia recurrence. The association differed according to AF type, suggesting that low Hb may reflect an adverse atrial substrate rather than a procedural effect.

AI.tldr: 低血红蛋白水平与房颤消融术后心律失常复发风险增加相关，尤其在非阵发性房颤患者中，提示其可能反映不良心房基质。
AI.motivation: 低血红蛋白与血流动力学应激和不良心脏重构相关，但其对房颤消融术后心律失常复发的临床意义尚不明确，本研究旨在探讨这一关联。
AI.method: 回顾性研究纳入2014至2024年间接受房颤消融的2202例患者（射频消融1606例，冷冻球囊消融596例）。射频消融队列按血红蛋白四分位数分层，最低四分位切点（Hb < 12.4 g/dL）应用于冷冻球囊队列。主要终点为90天空白期后房颤或房性心动过速复发。
AI.result: 射频消融队列中，低血红蛋白与术后心律失常复发风险增高相关（校正HR 1.33，95% CI 1.07-1.65），多次手术后亦相关（校正HR 1.57，95% CI 1.22-2.02）。冷冻球囊队列中无显著关联（校正HR 1.03，95% CI 0.68-1.54）。消融方式与血红蛋白水平的交互作用无统计学意义（交互P=0.177）。汇总分析中，低血红蛋白与总人群心律失常复发独立相关（校正HR 1.24，95% CI 1.03-1.50），在非阵发性房颤患者中亦相关（校正HR 1.43，95% CI 1.11-1.85），但在阵发性房颤患者中无显著关联（校正HR 1.06，95% CI 0.80-1.39）。
AI.conclusion: 低血红蛋白水平与房颤消融术后心律失常复发风险增加相关，且关联因房颤类型而异，提示低血红蛋白可能反映不良心房基质而非手术效应。这一发现对术前风险分层有潜在意义，但需前瞻性研究验证，且摘要未报告具体复发率及多因素模型细节。

summary_zh:
背景：低血红蛋白（Hb）与血流动力学应激和不良心脏重构相关。然而，其对心房颤动（AF）消融后心律失常复发的临床意义尚不明确。

方法：我们回顾性研究了2014年至2024年间接受AF消融的2202例患者（射频消融[RFA]：n = 1606；冷冻球囊消融[CBA]：n = 596）。在RFA队列中，患者按Hb四分位数分层，并将最低四分位数截止值（Hb < 12.4 g/dL）应用于CBA队列。主要终点是90天空白期后AF或房性心动过速复发。

结果：在RFA队列中，低Hb与索引手术后心律失常复发风险较高相关（调整后HR 1.33，95% CI 1.07-1.65），以及多次手术后（调整后HR 1.57，95% CI 1.22-2.02）。在CBA队列中未观察到显著关联（调整后HR 1.03，95% CI 0.68-1.54）。Hb水平与消融方式之间的交互作用无统计学意义（交互作用p = 0.177）。在汇总分析中，低Hb与总人群中心律失常复发独立相关（调整后HR 1.24，95% CI 1.03-1.50），在非阵发性AF患者中（调整后HR 1.43，95% CI 1.11-1.85），但在阵发性AF患者中则不相关（调整后HR 1.06，95% CI 0.80-1.39）。

结论：较低的Hb水平与心律失常复发风险增加相关。这种关联因AF类型而异，提示低Hb可能反映不良心房基质而非手术效应。

title: High-Density Spectral Analysis for Bi-Atrial Arrhythmogenic Substrate During Non-Paroxysmal Atrial Fibrillation
summary: Background Spectral analysis has been utilized to identify localized sites exhibiting high dominant frequency (DF) and high regularity-the critical arrhythmogenic substrate driving atrial fibrillation (AF). This study aimed to elucidate the spectral characteristics of focal activation (FoA) and rotational activation (RoA) sites during AF using a high-density mapping system.Methods CARTOFINDER mapping was prospectively performed in both atria of 47 consecutive non-paroxysmal AF patients using the Octaray catheter prior to ablation. Endocardial unipolar electrograms were exported offline for spectral analysis of DF and the regularity index (RI).Results CARTOFINDER assessed a total of 48 153 mapping points. Given substantial inter-subject variability in mean DF, the difference between each point's DF and the subject-level mean DF was defined as the dominant frequency deviation (DFD). The left atrium (LA) demonstrated significantly higher DFD and RI than the right atrium (both p < 0.001), with the LA roof recording the highest values across all segments. Both FoA and RoA sites exhibited significantly higher DFD and RI compared with sites without FoA and RoA (both p < 0.001). DFD and RI increased progressively with increasing FoA repetitions (both p < 0.001). In contrast, high-repetition RoA sites (> 16 repetitions) showed a significantly higher RI (0.42 ± 0.13 vs. 0.36 ± 0.12, p < 0.001) but a paradoxically lower DFD (0.14 ± 0.64 Hz vs. 0.26 ± 0.74 Hz, p < 0.001) compared with low-repetition RoA sites.Conclusions The combination of CARTOFINDER mapping and spectral analysis may contribute to the mechanistic understanding of non-paroxysmal AF.

AI.tldr: 在非阵发性房颤患者中，高密度标测显示左心房尤其是顶部具有更高的主导频率偏差和规律性指数，局灶激活与旋转激活位点的频谱特征不同，旋转激活高重复位点规律性更高但频率偏差更低。
AI.motivation: 频谱分析已用于识别房颤中高主导频率和高规律性的局部致心律失常基质，但局灶激活和旋转激活位点的频谱特征尚不明确，本研究旨在利用高密度标测系统阐明这些位点的频谱特性。
AI.method: 前瞻性纳入47例连续非阵发性房颤患者，在消融前使用Octaray导管进行双心房CARTOFINDER标测，离线导出心内膜单极电图进行主导频率和规律性指数的频谱分析。定义每个点的主导频率与患者平均主导频率的差值为主导频率偏差。
AI.result: 共分析48153个标测点。左心房的主导频率偏差和规律性指数均显著高于右心房（均p<0.001），左心房顶部在所有节段中记录到最高值。局灶激活和旋转激活位点的主导频率偏差和规律性指数均显著高于无局灶激活和旋转激活的位点（均p<0.001）。随着局灶激活重复次数增加，主导频率偏差和规律性指数逐渐升高（均p<0.001）。高重复旋转激活位点（>16次）的规律性指数显著更高（0.42±0.13 vs. 0.36±0.12，p<0.001），但主导频率偏差反而更低（0.14±0.64 Hz vs. 0.26±0.74 Hz，p<0.001）。
AI.conclusion: CARTOFINDER标测结合频谱分析可能有助于理解非阵发性房颤的机制，左心房尤其是顶部是致心律失常基质的主要区域，局灶激活和旋转激活具有不同的频谱特征，高重复旋转激活位点规律性高但频率偏差低，提示其机制可能不同。

summary_zh:
背景：频谱分析已被用于识别表现出高优势频率（DF）和高规律性的局部区域——即驱动心房颤动（AF）的关键致心律失常基质。本研究旨在利用高密度标测系统阐明AF期间局灶激动（FoA）和旋转激动（RoA）部位的频谱特征。

方法：对47例连续的非阵发性AF患者，在消融前使用Octaray导管前瞻性进行CARTOFINDER标测双心房。心内膜单极电图离线导出，用于DF和规律性指数（RI）的频谱分析。

结果：CARTOFINDER共评估了48 153个标测点。鉴于平均DF存在显著的个体间变异，将每个点的DF与受试者水平平均DF的差值定义为优势频率偏差（DFD）。左心房（LA）的DFD和RI显著高于右心房（均p < 0.001），其中LA顶部在所有节段中记录到最高值。与无FoA和RoA的部位相比，FoA和RoA部位的DFD和RI均显著更高（均p < 0.001）。随着FoA重复次数的增加，DFD和RI逐渐升高（均p < 0.001）。相反，与低重复次数的RoA部位相比，高重复次数RoA部位（> 16次重复）显示出显著更高的RI（0.42 ± 0.13 vs. 0.36 ± 0.12，p < 0.001），但DFD反而更低（0.14 ± 0.64 Hz vs. 0.26 ± 0.74 Hz，p < 0.001）。

结论：CARTOFINDER标测与频谱分析相结合可能有助于理解非阵发性AF的机制。

title: Redo Pulmonary Vein Isolation After Index Cryoballoon Ablation: Cryoballoon Versus Radiofrequency Redo Ablation for Recurrent Atrial Fibrillation
summary: Background: Data guiding the choice of energy source for redo pulmonary vein isolation (PVI) after index cryoballoon (CB) PVI are limited. We compared procedural findings, pulmonary vein (PV) reconnection patterns, and reported clinical outcomes after CB-redo versus radiofrequency (RF)-redo ablation in patients with recurrent atrial fibrillation (AF) following an index CB-PVI. Methods: We included a retrospective single-center cohort of 61 consecutive patients with symptomatic recurrent AF after prior CB-PVI who underwent redo ablation between 2019 and 2020 (CB redo, n = 32 vs. RF redo, n = 29). All patients had an index CB PVI (28 mm balloon). The primary reported outcome was freedom from atrial tachyarrhythmia after the blanking period. Results: Mean age was 66 ± 10 years; 41 (67%) were men. Time from index procedure to redo: CB redo 323 ± 72 days vs. RF redo 238 ± 48 days (p < 0.001). All patients had ≥1 PV at redo. Mean reconnected PVs per patient: CB 2.1 ± 1.1 vs. RF 1.7 ± 0.6 (p = 0.08). Right inferior PV reconnection was more frequent after CB redo (69% vs. 41%; p = 0.03). Early recurrence during the 90-day blanking period was CB 8/32 (25.0%) vs. RF 9/29 (31.0%) (p = 0.54). At 12 months, recurrence was CB 7/32 (21.9%) vs. RF 6/29 (20.7%) (unadjusted p = 0.75). Kaplan-Meier log-rank p = 0.88. Adjusted Cox HR (CB vs. RF) = 1.05 (95% CI 0.40-2.76; p = 0.92). Total outcome events = 13. No major periprocedural complications were observed. Conclusions: No statistically significant difference in arrhythmia recurrence between CB redo and RF redo strategies was detected. However, the small sample size, limited event count, non-random treatment selection, and wide statistical uncertainty preclude conclusions regarding equivalence.

AI.tldr: 在初次冷冻球囊PVI后复发房颤的患者中，再次消融采用冷冻球囊或射频能量，12个月心律失常复发率无显著差异（21.9% vs 20.7%），但样本量小、事件数少，无法判定等效性。
AI.motivation: 初次冷冻球囊肺静脉隔离（PVI）后房颤复发行再次PVI时，选择何种能量来源（冷冻球囊 vs 射频）缺乏循证依据，既往研究数据有限。本研究旨在比较两种再次消融策略的操作特征、肺静脉重连模式及临床结局。
AI.method: 回顾性单中心队列研究，纳入2019-2020年因初次冷冻球囊PVI（28 mm球囊）后症状性房颤复发接受再次消融的61例连续患者（冷冻球囊再次消融32例，射频再次消融29例）。主要报告终点为空白期后无房性快速性心律失常。统计方法包括卡方检验、Kaplan-Meier生存分析及多因素校正Cox回归。
AI.result: 平均年龄66±10岁，男性41例（67%）。初次手术至再次消融时间：冷冻球囊组323±72天 vs 射频组238±48天（p<0.001）。人均重连肺静脉数：冷冻球囊组2.1±1.1 vs 射频组1.7±0.6（p=0.08）；右下肺静脉重连在冷冻球囊组更常见（69% vs 41%，p=0.03）。90天空白期内早期复发：冷冻球囊组8/32（25.0%） vs 射频组9/29（31.0%）（p=0.54）。12个月复发：冷冻球囊组7/32（21.9%） vs 射频组6/29（20.7%）（未校正p=0.75）；Kaplan-Meier log-rank p=0.88；校正Cox HR（冷冻球囊 vs 射频）=1.05（95%CI 0.40-2.76；p=0.92）。总结局事件13例。围术期无重大并发症。
AI.conclusion: 再次消融采用冷冻球囊或射频策略，房颤复发率无统计学显著差异。但样本量小、事件数有限、非随机治疗选择及宽泛的统计不确定性，无法得出等效性结论。临床选择能量来源时需结合患者个体特征及术者经验，未来需更大规模随机研究验证。

summary_zh: 背景：指导初次冷冻球囊（CB）肺静脉隔离（PVI）后再次肺静脉隔离（PVI）选择能量来源的数据有限。我们比较了初次CB-PVI后复发心房颤动（AF）患者接受CB再次消融与射频（RF）再次消融的手术发现、肺静脉（PV）重连模式及报告的临床结局。方法：我们纳入了一个回顾性单中心队列，连续61例既往CB-PVI后症状性复发AF患者，于2019年至2020年间接受再次消融（CB再次消融，n=32 vs. RF再次消融，n=29）。所有患者均接受过初次CB PVI（28 mm球囊）。主要报告结局为空窗期后无房性快速性心律失常。结果：平均年龄66±10岁；41例（67%）为男性。从初次手术至再次消融的时间：CB再次消融323±72天 vs. RF再次消融238±48天（p<0.001）。所有患者在再次消融时均有≥1条PV。每位患者平均重连PV数：CB 2.1±1.1 vs. RF 1.7±0.6（p=0.08）。右下肺静脉重连在CB再次消融后更常见（69% vs. 41%；p=0.03）。90天空窗期内早期复发：CB 8/32（25.0%） vs. RF 9/29（31.0%）（p=0.54）。12个月时，复发：CB 7/32（21.9%） vs. RF 6/29（20.7%）（未校正p=0.75）。Kaplan-Meier log-rank p=0.88。校正Cox HR（CB vs. RF）=1.05（95% CI 0.40-2.76；p=0.92）。总结局事件=13。未观察到主要围手术期并发症。结论：未检测到CB再次消融与RF再次消融策略之间心律失常复发有统计学显著差异。然而，小样本量、有限的事件数、非随机治疗选择以及宽泛的统计不确定性妨碍了关于等效性的结论。

title: Acoustic effects during pulsed field ablation: measurement and control of bubble and void formation.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Pulsed field ablation (PFA) is an emerging treatment option for arrhythmogenic myocardial tissue and solid tumors. PFA uses high voltage pulses to alter the electric potential across cell membranes, creating pores and eventual cell death. Bubble nucleation due to gas evolution at the electrode/electrolyte interface follows the delivery of current from the power generator to the body. Here, we investigate the acoustic effects induced by PFA to maximize the electroporation effect without pressure-driven damage.

METHODS: Acoustic signals created by a PFA probe in saline were measured with a hydrophone. The lethality of PFA was tested in vitro in a 3D tissue mimic to resolve a ratio of cell death area to pressure. Mechanical damage created by PFA was then evaluated by gross measurements in agarose tissue mimics of different stiffness. Electrical resistance was tested with a plant-tissue model.

RESULTS: Monophasic pulses create smaller pressure waves (p < 0.05) and decrease the lethal threshold (p < 0.05) compared to biphasic pulses. The length of the delay within a PFA pulse train has a significant effect on pressure (p < 0.05) and insignificant effect on ablation areas (p = 0.9995 between 5 and 100 μs and p = 0.9997 between 50 and 100 μs). The cathode electrode creates more mechanical damage than the anode electrode (p < 0.05). Conductivity as a function of electric field is more accurately described with a double sigmoid compared to a single sigmoid model (R2 = 0.9898 vs 0.8772).

CONCLUSIONS: Bubble formation and void formation are generally undesirable when using PFA. This paper presents the first characterization of the pressure waves created by PFA and provides strategies for improving an electrical waveform to maximize the electroporation effect without violent acoustic waves.

AI.tldr: 脉冲场消融中，单相脉冲较双相脉冲产生更小的压力波并降低致死阈值，阴极较阳极造成更多机械损伤，优化电波形可最大化电穿孔效应并减少气泡和空腔形成。
AI.motivation: 脉冲场消融（PFA）是治疗心律失常和实体肿瘤的新兴方法，但电流传递过程中电极/电解质界面气体会导致气泡成核，可能引起压力驱动损伤。目前缺乏对PFA诱导声学效应的表征，需要研究如何最大化电穿孔效果同时避免机械损伤。
AI.method: 体外实验研究。使用水听器测量PFA探头在生理盐水中产生的声学信号；在3D组织模拟物中测试PFA杀伤效果，计算细胞死亡面积与压力的比值；在不同硬度的琼脂糖组织模拟物中通过大体测量评估机械损伤；使用植物组织模型测试电阻。统计方法包括比较单相与双相脉冲、脉冲串内延迟长度、阴极与阳极的差异，以及电导率-电场关系的模型拟合。
AI.result: 单相脉冲较双相脉冲产生更小的压力波（p<0.05）并降低致死阈值（p<0.05）。脉冲串内延迟长度对压力有显著影响（p<0.05），但对消融面积无显著影响（5与100 μs间p=0.9995，50与100 μs间p=0.9997）。阴极电极较阳极电极造成更多机械损伤（p<0.05）。电导率随电场的变化用双S形模型拟合优于单S形模型（R²=0.9898 vs 0.8772）。
AI.conclusion: 气泡和空腔形成在PFA中通常是不利的。本研究首次表征了PFA产生的压力波，并提供了优化电波形的策略，以最大化电穿孔效果同时避免剧烈声波。这些发现对改进PFA的临床安全性和有效性具有潜在意义，但研究为体外实验，需进一步在体验证。

summary_zh:
背景：脉冲场消融（PFA）是一种新兴的治疗致心律失常性心肌组织和实体肿瘤的选择。PFA 使用高压脉冲改变细胞膜两侧的电势，形成孔隙并最终导致细胞死亡。在电流从功率发生器传输到身体后，由于电极/电解质界面处的气体逸出，会形成气泡成核。在此，我们研究 PFA 引起的声学效应，以在不造成压力驱动损伤的情况下最大化电穿孔效果。

方法：使用水听器测量 PFA 探头在生理盐水中产生的声信号。在体外 3D 组织模拟物中测试 PFA 的致死性，以解析细胞死亡面积与压力的比值。然后通过在不同硬度的琼脂糖组织模拟物中进行大体测量来评估 PFA 造成的机械损伤。使用植物组织模型测试电阻。

结果：与双相脉冲相比，单相脉冲产生更小的压力波（p < 0.05）并降低致死阈值（p < 0.05）。PFA 脉冲串内延迟的长度对压力有显著影响（p < 0.05），对消融面积影响不显著（5 与 100 μs 之间 p = 0.9995，50 与 100 μs 之间 p = 0.9997）。阴极电极比阳极电极造成更多的机械损伤（p < 0.05）。电导率作为电场的函数，用双 S 形曲线比单 S 形曲线模型描述更准确（R2 = 0.9898 vs 0.8772）。

结论：使用 PFA 时，气泡形成和空洞形成通常是不希望的。本文首次对 PFA 产生的压力波进行了表征，并提供了改进电波形以最大化电穿孔效果而不产生剧烈声波的策略。

title: Smoking Habit Change and Atrial Fibrillation Risk in Patients With Diabetes Mellitus: A Nationwide Observational Cohort Study in Korea
summary: Background Smoking and diabetes mellitus (DM) are known risk factors for atrial fibrillation (AF), but the impact of smoking habit changes on AF risk in patients with DM remains unclear. We aimed to evaluate the association between smoking habit changes and incident AF in patients with DM.Methods Using the Korean nationwide claims database, we identified patients with DM, defined as fasting glucose ≥ 126 mg/dL or use of antidiabetic medications. Smoking habits were assessed by self-reported questionnaires from two health assessments within a two-year interval, and patients were categorized as never smokers, ex-smokers, quitters, or current smokers. The primary outcome was incident AF.Results Among 1,354,907 patients with DM (median follow-up 5.93 years, interquartile range 5.30-6.33; mean age 60.0 years [SD 11.8], 51.0% male), current smokers had a 20% higher risk of AF than never smokers (adjusted hazard ratio [95% confidence interval], 1.20 [1.16-1.24]). While ex-smokers and quitters had lower risks than current smokers, their risk remained elevated relative to never smokers, by 8.5% (1.09 [1.04-1.13]) and 10% (1.10 [1.06-1.15]), respectively. Among patients with new-onset DM or DM duration < 5 years, quitters showed comparable AF risk to that of never smokers (1.06 [0.97-1.15] and 1.04 [0.95-1.13], respectively).Conclusion Smoking cessation in patients with DM was associated with a lower risk of AF than continued smoking. Especially in new-onset DM, AF risk in quitters approached that of never smokers. Encouraging smoking cessation may be beneficial for preventing new-onset AF in patients with DM.

AI.tldr: 在韩国糖尿病患者中，当前吸烟者房颤风险较从不吸烟者高20%，戒烟者风险低于继续吸烟者但仍高于从不吸烟者，新发糖尿病患者戒烟后房颤风险接近从不吸烟者。
AI.motivation: 吸烟和糖尿病均是房颤的已知危险因素，但吸烟习惯改变对糖尿病患者房颤风险的影响尚不明确，既往证据存在缺口。
AI.method: 基于韩国全国医保索赔数据库的观察性队列研究，纳入1,354,907例糖尿病患者（空腹血糖≥126 mg/dL或使用降糖药），通过两年内两次健康评估的自报问卷确定吸烟习惯，分为从不吸烟、已戒烟、新戒烟和当前吸烟四组，主要终点为新发房颤，采用多因素调整Cox回归分析。
AI.result: 中位随访5.93年（IQR 5.30-6.33），平均年龄60.0岁（SD 11.8），男性51.0%。当前吸烟者房颤风险较从不吸烟者高20%（调整HR 1.20，95%CI 1.16-1.24）；已戒烟者和新戒烟者风险分别较从不吸烟者高8.5%（HR 1.09，95%CI 1.04-1.13）和10%（HR 1.10，95%CI 1.06-1.15），但均低于当前吸烟者。在新发糖尿病或糖尿病病程<5年的患者中，新戒烟者房颤风险与从不吸烟者相当（HR 1.06，95%CI 0.97-1.15；HR 1.04，95%CI 0.95-1.13）。
AI.conclusion: 糖尿病患者戒烟与房颤风险降低相关，尤其在新发糖尿病患者中戒烟后风险接近从不吸烟者，鼓励戒烟可能有助于预防糖尿病患者新发房颤；但本研究为观察性设计，吸烟习惯依赖自报问卷，残余混杂可能影响因果推断。

summary_zh:
背景：吸烟和糖尿病（DM）是已知的心房颤动（AF）危险因素，但吸烟习惯改变对DM患者AF风险的影响尚不清楚。我们旨在评估DM患者吸烟习惯改变与新发AF之间的关联。

方法：利用韩国全国理赔数据库，我们识别了DM患者，定义为空腹血糖≥126 mg/dL或使用降糖药物。吸烟习惯通过两年间隔内两次健康评估的自报问卷进行评估，患者被分类为从不吸烟者、戒烟者、新戒烟者或当前吸烟者。主要结局是新发AF。

结果：在1,354,907名DM患者中（中位随访5.93年，四分位距5.30-6.33；平均年龄60.0岁[SD 11.8]，51.0%男性），当前吸烟者的AF风险比从不吸烟者高20%（调整风险比[95%置信区间]，1.20[1.16-1.24]）。虽然戒烟者和新戒烟者的风险低于当前吸烟者，但其风险相对于从不吸烟者仍升高，分别高8.5%（1.09[1.04-1.13]）和10%（1.10[1.06-1.15]）。在新发DM或DM病程<5年的患者中，新戒烟者的AF风险与从不吸烟者相当（分别为1.06[0.97-1.15]和1.04[0.95-1.13]）。

结论：DM患者戒烟与持续吸烟相比，AF风险较低。特别是在新发DM中，新戒烟者的AF风险接近从不吸烟者。鼓励戒烟可能有益于预防DM患者的新发AF。

title: Stellate Ganglion Block Reduces the Incidence of Postoperative Atrial Fibrillation After Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting
summary: Background Postoperative atrial fibrillation (POAF) is associated with sympathetic overactivity. Stellate ganglion is a potential target for intervention.Objectives The aim of this study was to examine the efficacy of preemptive left stellate ganglion block (SGB) in reducing POAF in patients undergoing coronary artery bypass grafting with cardiopulmonary bypass.Methods Patients were randomized to the SGB group or the control group. The primary endpoint was the incidence of POAF within 5 days postoperatively. Secondary endpoints included POAF-associated characteristics and recovery indicators.Results A total of 124 patients underwent initial randomization, with 108 in modified intention-to-treat and 98 in per-protocol analysis. In modified intention-to-treat analysis, POAF occurred in 18.5% of the SGB group and 44.4% of the control group (OR: 0.288; 95% CI: 0.106-0.731; P = 0.007). Per-protocol analysis yielded consistent results. SGB group showed significantly lower POAF burden, shorter duration of first POAF episode, fewer POAF episodes and antiarrhythmic treatments, decreased C-reactive protein, interleukin-6, high-sensitivity cardiac troponin T, and creatine kinase-MB on certain postoperative time points, and decreased postoperative hospitalization than the control group (all P < 0.05). Exploratory subgroup analyses suggested that the association between SGB pretreatment and lower POAF incidence was more pronounced among patients without diabetes (OR: 0.10; 95% CI: 0.019-0.480; P = 0.004) and those at lower baseline risk of POAF (OR: 0.10; 95% CI: 0.005-0.642; P = 0.040).Conclusions In patients undergoing coronary artery bypass grafting with cardiopulmonary bypass, preemptive left SGB was associated with a reduced incidence of POAF within 5 postoperative days. Exploratory subgroup analyses suggested a potentially greater association among patients without diabetes and those at lower risk of POAF.

AI.tldr: 在体外循环冠脉搭桥患者中，预防性左侧星状神经节阻滞使术后5天内房颤发生率从44.4%降至18.5%（OR 0.288，P=0.007）。
AI.motivation: 术后房颤（POAF）与交感神经过度激活相关，星状神经节是潜在干预靶点，但预防性左侧星状神经节阻滞（SGB）在体外循环冠脉搭桥（CABG）患者中的疗效尚缺乏随机对照证据。
AI.method: 随机对照研究，纳入行体外循环CABG的患者，随机分为SGB组与对照组，初始随机124例，改良意向性治疗分析108例、符合方案分析98例。主要终点为术后5天内POAF发生率；次要终点包括POAF负荷、首次发作持续时间、发作次数、抗心律失常治疗、炎症与心肌损伤标志物（CRP、IL-6、hs-cTnT、CK-MB）及术后住院时间。
AI.result: 改良意向性治疗分析中，SGB组POAF发生率为18.5%，对照组为44.4%（OR 0.288；95%CI 0.106-0.731；P=0.007），符合方案分析结果一致。SGB组POAF负荷更低、首次发作持续时间更短、发作次数及抗心律失常治疗更少，术后部分时间点CRP、IL-6、hs-cTnT、CK-MB降低，术后住院时间缩短（均P<0.05）。探索性亚组分析提示，非糖尿病患者（OR 0.10；95%CI 0.019-0.480；P=0.004）及基线POAF风险较低者（OR 0.10；95%CI 0.005-0.642；P=0.040）中关联更明显。
AI.conclusion: 在体外循环CABG患者中，预防性左侧SGB与术后5天内POAF发生率降低相关，并可能减轻炎症与心肌损伤、缩短住院时间；非糖尿病及低基线风险患者可能获益更明显。该结果为POAF的神经调控预防提供了随机对照证据，但亚组分析为探索性，样本量有限，需更大规模研究验证。

summary_zh:
背景：术后心房颤动（POAF）与交感神经过度活跃有关。星状神经节是潜在的干预靶点。

目的：本研究旨在探讨预防性左侧星状神经节阻滞（SGB）在降低接受体外循环冠状动脉旁路移植术患者POAF中的疗效。

方法：患者被随机分配至SGB组或对照组。主要终点为术后5天内POAF的发生率。次要终点包括POAF相关特征和恢复指标。

结果：共有124例患者进行了初步随机化，其中108例纳入改良意向治疗分析，98例纳入符合方案分析。在改良意向治疗分析中，SGB组POAF发生率为18.5%，对照组为44.4%（OR：0.288；95% CI：0.106-0.731；P = 0.007）。符合方案分析得出一致结果。与对照组相比，SGB组显示出显著更低的POAF负荷、首次POAF发作持续时间更短、POAF发作次数和抗心律失常治疗更少、术后某些时间点C反应蛋白、白细胞介素-6、高敏心肌肌钙蛋白T和肌酸激酶-MB降低，以及术后住院时间缩短（所有P < 0.05）。探索性亚组分析提示，SGB预处理与较低POAF发生率之间的关联在无糖尿病患者（OR：0.10；95% CI：0.019-0.480；P = 0.004）和基线POAF风险较低的患者（OR：0.10；95% CI：0.005-0.642；P = 0.040）中更为明显。

结论：在接受体外循环冠状动脉旁路移植术的患者中，预防性左侧SGB与术后5天内POAF发生率降低相关。探索性亚组分析提示，在无糖尿病患者和POAF风险较低的患者中，这种关联可能更强。

title: Electrical storm: the quintessence of challenges in arrhythmology
summary: The lecture is devoted to electrical storm (ES) – a state of electrical instability of the heart with the occurrence of sustained ventricular tachycardias, at least three in 24 hours, which is accompanied by high mortality and requires urgent multidisciplinary treatment. ES is often found in patients with an implanted cardioverter-defibrillator. Most cases of ES occur on the background of structural heart pathology and manifest with monomorphic ventricular tachycardia. Polymorphic ventricular tachycardia and ventricular fibrillation are more likely in conditions of acute ischemia and primary electrical diseases (channelopathies). In the treatment of ES, the search and correction of triggers, ICD reprogramming, drug therapy with the use of beta-blockers, sedatives and antiarrhythmic drugs, autonomic modulation, catheter ablation and hemodynamic support are important. The choice of initial therapy and its subsequent stepwise escalation are based on the risk stratification of ES. The theoretical material of the lecture is illustrated by the authors’ own clinical observation. The lecture will be useful for doctors - cardiologists, anesthesiologists, emergency medicine and family doctors.

title: Wearable devices for atrial fibrillation screening in older adults: a scoping review protocol
summary: This scoping review aims to map the existing literature on the use of wearable devices (smartwatches, mobile ECG monitors, PPG-based devices) for screening and detection of atrial fibrillation in older adults (≥65 years) in primary care, community, or home settings.
